svg.title: KELNA 0.14 — B.Cu, physical underside, horizontally mirrored
svg.desc: Reference overlay: native B.Silkscreen is empty. The subdued readable labels are front component reference names, anchored to horizontally mirrored KiCad reference-field coordinates and locally offset only for clarity. These labels are not fabrication silkscreen. Native KiCad copper, pads, vias and exact drill geometry. Primary-layer copper only; no opposite-layer overlay. Dark zones, vivid tracks, gold through-hole pads, grey via annuli. Board-cropped view.
